name: NSF America's Seed Fund (SBIR/STTR)
program: NSF SBIR/STTR Phase I and II
collect_note: Collected from the official Grants.gov API (agency NSF, SBIR/STTR calls): both live solicitations, NSF 26-510 and NSF 26-511, are listed with their 4 March 2027 deadline, and any future NSF SBIR/STTR solicitation posted to Grants.gov is picked up automatically.

sample.title: NSF SBIR/STTR Phase I, Phase II and Fast-Track (NSF 26-510)

evidence: Channels tried 2026-11-12: Grants.gov search2 (agencies NSF, keyword 'SBIR STTR', oppStatuses forecasted|posted) returned 1 unrelated hit (PD-98-1331) and oppNum 'NSF 26-510' returned 0 hits, so NSF SBIR is not on Grants.gov. seedfund.nsf.gov/solicitations/ is static HTML that links NSF 26-510 and 26-511 but carries no deadlines and its linked solicitation pages sit on another host (nsf.gov), so a list with detail hop cannot read them. The nsf.gov solicitation page is static HTML (30 KB) with 'Full Proposal Deadline(s)': July 27 2026, November 04 2026, March 04 2027, July 07 2027. Audit 2026-11-20: Grants.gov search2 keyword 'NSF 26-510' / 'SBIR' / agencies=NSF: WORKS. NSF posts 26-510 (Developing Deep Technologies, opp id 364255) and 26-511 (Pilot Emphasis on Scientific Instrumentation, id 362551), both posted, close 2027-03-04.; Current config: html self on the nsf26-510 solicitation page with a hardcoded date list regex (July 27 2026|Nov 4 2026|Mar 4 2027|Jul 7 2027). It passes today but sees only that one solicitation number and will not see 26-511 or any successor.; RSS/WP/sitemap not needed once the official API route works (C4 step 1).
edge_risk: A replacement solicitation (new NSF number) would not be seen until this page changes; the deadline_regex is tied to the four listed dates.
